semantics.initial: Missing/empty tab name => true; otherwise require visible, not minimized and getFocusTab matching the requested tab (empty selected tab matches the synapse window itself).
semantics.focus_true: Re-query selected tab; no OS active-state comparison.
semantics.focus_false: Re-query visibility/minimization and selected tab; losing OS focus alone does not imply false.
semantics.changeActiveTab: Compare data.name with the requested tab.
semantics.activeTabChanged: Compare data.tabName with the requested tab.
semantics.popup: The mounted popup closes only after this helper has been true while open and later becomes false.
